editorial.blurb: A beloved Korean kitchen where the owner-chef pours care into every dish, earning loyal crowds who return again and again for authentic flavors and generous portions.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for lunch specials to get the best value, and arrive early to avoid the long dinner-time waits—or call ahead to order the Seafood Sundubu if you love heat.
